 About the match
 On this page you can find the Sevilla vs Alaves match lineup for LaLiga — Round 12 - First Leg, on Friday 06-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Sevilla lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Suazo, while Alaves sets up in a 5-3-2 led by Guevara. Sevilla is led by head coach Luis García, while Alaves is managed by Quique Sánchez Flores. The match is played at Estadio R. Sanchez Pizjuan.
